name: Doki Doki Let this dream be forever
source:
This is a mod about a guy who really wants to achieve his dream. And after some events this opportunity opens up for him. However, for something like this he needs to try hard! Therefore, the main character accepts all the difficulties and begins to change his life. 

[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/let-this-dream-be-forever]dokimods.me[/url]]
translation:
这个模组讲述一个男生的故事，他一心想要实现自己的梦想。一系列事情发生后，机会终于出现在他眼前。然而，要做到这一点，还得狠狠下些功夫！于是主角决定直面所有困难，开始改变自己的人生。

［摘自[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/let-this-dream-be-forever]dokimods.me[/url]］
